name: nizhalpoocha
description: Nizhalpoocha — a hidden-role multiplayer mystery set in monsoon Kerala.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
